scripts.test:canary: npm run lint:canary:should-fail && npm run lint:canary:should-pass && npm run lint:canary:absolute-units && echo '✅ All canary tests passed'
scripts.lint:canary:absolute-units: npx stylelint __tests__/style-guardrails/canary-absolute-units.test.css 2>&1 | grep -q 'Unexpected unit' && echo '✅ Canary absolute-units test correctly fails' || (echo '❌ Canary absolute-units test should fail but passed' && exit 1) && node scripts/check-inline-styles.cjs __tests__/style-guardrails/canary-inline-absolute-units.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -q 'Absolute units found' && echo '✅ Canary inline-absolute-units test correctly fails' || (echo '❌ Canary inline-absolute-units test should fail but passed' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:canary:should-fail: node scripts/check-inline-styles.cjs __tests__/style-guardrails/canary-inline-style.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -q 'Inline style found' && echo '✅ Canary inline-style test correctly fails' || (echo '❌ Canary inline-style test should fail but passed' && exit 1)
scripts.lint:canary:should-pass: node scripts/check-inline-styles.cjs __tests__/style-guardrails/canary-inline-style-allowed.test.tsx 2>&1 | grep -q 'No inline styles' && echo '✅ Canary inline-style-allowed test correctly passes' || (echo '❌ Canary inline-style-allowed test should pass but failed' && exit 1)
